head.title: jlddst72001

xf:group.xf:group: Designation of a short-term overheating issue is notified when a listed issue (including DR) is detected as it fulfills the criteria of three short-term overheating indicators below and it is detected again for the same reason within ten trading days from the following day of the initial detection. The closing price of the day should be higher than the closing prices on the initial detection day and the most recent trading day.
(Price) The closing price of the day is up by 30% or more compared to the average closing price of the recent 40 trading days.
(Turnover) The average turnover of the recent two trading days is up by 500% or more compared to that of the recent 40 trading days.
(Volatility) The average intra-day volatility of the recent two trading days is up by 50% or more compared to that of the recent 40 trading days.

The concerned issue is designated as a short-term overheated issue when it meets all criteria of the three short-term overheating indicators above again within ten trading days. For designation, as same as the prior notice, the closing price of the day should be higher than the closing prices on the initial detection day and the most recent trading day.

As for an issue of which outstanding stocks are scarce, prior notice for designation is given in order to counteract swiftly when any of the short-term overheating indicators of the issue meets the criteria. When any of the indicators of the issue falls under one of the criteria again within ten trading days from the prior notice, it is designated as a short-term overheated issue.

Criteria for issues of which outstanding stocks are scarce are different by the type of stocks. As for common stocks, when the ratio of outstanding stocks of an issue designated as an administrative issue (including investment attention issues for the KOSDAQ market) is 3% (5% for the KOSDAQ market) or less of the total listed securities, or the number of outstanding stocks is less than 300 thousand, the issue is classified into an issue of which outstanding stocks are scarce.

As for stocks other than common stocks, an administrative issue or an issue of which the number of listed stocks is less than 100 thousand is categorized as an issue of which outstanding stocks are scarce.

As for the KOSDAQ market, an issue of which trading is suspended due to capital reduction, reverse stock split, or capital increase or decrease during a corporate rehabilitation procedure for 30 trading days or longer, and is resumed within the recent six months, is subject to the criteria of issues of which outstanding stocks are scarce.

When the number of trading days is 20 or more out of the most recent 40 trading days, and the issue meets all of the criteria, it is designated as an overheated short-selling issue. The short-selling ratio criterion is quarterly adjusted for KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets respectively to three times (upper limit is 20%) the ratio of the most recent quarter.
<Designation criteria of an overheated short-selling issue(as of Apr.16, 2018)>

VI with static price range is activated when a potential execution price exceeds the price range of ±10% of a single price just before the quotation receipt. It is aimed at alleviating cumulative and rather long-term price changes caused by a specific quotation or multiple quotations.

Conditions for CB activation are categorized into three phases. The first phase of CB is activated when the KOSPI index (KOSDAQ index) falls by 8% or more compared to that of the previous day’s close and the fall lasts for one minute.

The second phase is triggered when the index drops by 15% or more compared to the previous day’s close, goes down further by another 1% or more compared to the first activation point, and the drop lasts for one minute.

The third phase takes effect when the index plunges by 20% or more compared to the previous day after the activation of the second phase, falls further by 1% or more compared to the second activation point, and the fall lasts for one minute.

Each phase of CB is triggered once a day and the first and second phases are not activated from 40 minutes before the market close (14:50) to secure time for closing prices to be determined. The third phase of CB may be activated after 40 minutes before the market close (14:50); however, it is not activated after 10 minutes before the market close (15:20), in which quotations for periodic call auction are received to determine closing prices.
<Conditions for CB activation and market measures >
KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls by 8% or more compared to the previous day (The fall lasts for one minute.)
The entire market is suspended for 20 minutes. (Only cancellation of quotations is allowed.)
After CB activation, single price call auction is in operation for 10 minutes, followed by continuous auction.
KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls by 15% or more compared to the previous day.
An additional fall by 1% or more follows compared to the first activation point. (Both conditions should be satisfied and the fall should last for one minute.)
KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls by 20% or more compared to the previous day.
An additional fall by 1% or more follows compared to the second activation point. (Both conditions should be satisfied and the fall should last for one minute.)
The market is closed when the third phase is activated. (All quotations including quotations to be cancelled may not be submitted.)
All kinds of trading, such as after-hours trade, purchasing treasury stocks, etc. are not allowed after the market close.

Sidecar is activated when conditions as described below are met for the respective markets. It is activated once a day regardless of the direction of the quotations. Since the activation criteria are applied after five minutes from the market open, practically, it may be triggered from 09:06.
KOSPI market: the futures price of KOSPI200 index changes by 5% or more compared to the base price and the change lasts for one minute
KOSDAQ market: the futures price of KOSDAQ150 rises (drops) by 6% or more compared to the base price and the KOSDAQ150 index rises (drops) by 3% or further and the rise (fall) lasts for one minute

When the price rises, the validity of bid quotations for program trading is suspended for five minutes while that of ask quotations is suspended when the price falls (including quotations for cancellation and modification)

w2:textbox.label: Causes for Designation and Specific Criteria

xf:group.xf:group: It is crucial that investors are provided with sufficient information on management and financial status by a listed corporation in order for them to decide whether to buy or sell the stocks and set appropriate prices for trading. Plus, it is essential for a corporation to establish an independent decision-making structure including appointment of outside directors, etc. in order to secure confidence from investors.

However, if the sales of the corporation are not stable or the profit making structure is not sustainable, it is not appropriate for the corporation to be listed on the market although such information for investment is provided within the market in a transparent manner.

Moreover, if the stocks of the corporation are not traded actively or fair prices are not formed due to insufficient stock distribution, or low trading volume or market capitalization, investors need to be informed of such facts for their investment decisions.

Against these backdrops, KRX designates administrative issues to protect investors by considering transparency of the issues, business sustainability, trade-related conditions, etc. as mentioned above.

w2:textbox.label: Reason and duration of trading suspension

xf:group.xf:group: KRX may halt trade of an issue when enough time to inform investors of company information is required or normal trade execution of the issue is disrupted by a surge of trade. This is aimed at calling investors’ attention and promoting stable trading on the market.

w2:textbox.label: Trading suspension in compliance with the disclosure regulations
※ Major reasons for trading suspension are listed here. For other reasons, refer to the relevant regulations.

xf:group.xf:group: Disclosing material information of a listed company: for 30 minutes from the disclosure*
Designation of unfaithful disclosure corporation (5 point penalty): the designation day (one day) (not applicable to the KONEX market)

w2:textbox.label:
A surge in trading volume due to rumors or news reports is likely: 30 minutes should pass from when a disclosure is requested to when the response to the inquired disclosure is made*
(If the rumor is still not eliminated despite the response to the inquired disclosure, the suspension of trading may be prolonged.)

When a company does not respond to the inquired disclosure
- KOSPI market: trade is suspended from when the company misses the deadline for a disclosure to when the disclosure is made (30 minutes should pass after disclosing material information* )
- KOSDAQ and KONEX markets: trade is suspended from when the company misses the deadline for a disclosure to 30 minutes after the disclosure is made*

xf:group.xf:group: When KRX deems necessary to protect investors: for one day (However, it may extend the period further if it deems necessary.)

* If the disclosure is made after 14:30, 60 minutes before the market close of the regular session, trading is resumed on the following trading day. If it is made before the regular session opens (09:00), trading is resumed 30 minutes after the market open (09:30).

w2:textbox.label: Trading suspension in compliance with other regulations

xf:group.xf:group: Designation of administrative issues (not applicable to the KONEX market): for one day (when the annual report for the latest fiscal year has not been submitted: by the submission date, when the corporation has filed an application for commencement of corporate rehabilitation procedure: by the commencement determination date)
When a cause of delisting or listing maintenance review arises: from the day when the cause of delisting is identified to the day when the cause is solved
When there is a request for submission of stock certificates for stock split, reverse stock split, stock swap, stock transfer, etc.: until the day of listing change of the stock certificates

When an exchange clearing member fails to deliver securities that have been sold by the settlement deadline or is likely to do so: by the day when the cause of trading suspension is deemed to be solved
When the trade is likely to lack fairness significantly - KOSDAQ market: one day (under 5 days if KRX deems necessary) - KONEX market: one day
When a case deemed to be necessary for public interests and investor protection: until the cause of trading suspension is deemed to be solved
When the Market Oversight Commission requests suspension of trading for issues designated as investment alert issues or investment risk issues: the requested period
When there is likely to be an electronic system error due to a surge in quotations: trading is resumed after considering quotations and trading situations
If necessary for market management: trading is resumed after considering market and trading situations

w2:textbox.label: Meanwhile, trading of subscription warrants, subscription right certificates, and ELWs which are based on the trading-suspended equities, may also be suspended.
Criteria on issues to be delisted and trading of such issues

xf:group.xf:group: The causes for delisting of listed stocks include a failure to submit regular reports, auditor’s opinion, capital stock impairment, etc. For further details, please refer to the listing regulations of the KRX markets in the Regulation Menu on the KRX’s website (http://global.krx.co.kr → Regulation → Regulations).
* Relevant regulations: KOSPI Market Listing Regulation §48, KOSDAQ market Listing Regulation §38, etc.
A shareholder who has shares of an issue scheduled to be delisted is provided with a 7-day grace period (seven trading days) to convert them into money at the last moment before delisting.
Issues to be delisted are traded in periodic call auction at 30-minute intervals during the regular session (09:00 – 15:30, 14 times a day), and they are exempt from the daily price limit.

To make the KOSDAQ market sounder, KRX started to designate, as an “investment alert issue,” stocks of a company that requires attention for investment, so that investors are fully informed of the company prior to making investment decisions.
KRX designates a company as an investment alert issue that falls under the criteria of regular or timely designation.

w2:textbox.label:
(Regular designation) On the first trading day in May annually, KRX designates an investment alert issue when the concerned company falls under the Criteria for Identification of Corporate Insolvency Risks,* considering qualitative and quantitative factors, including business, finance, management, etc.
* Annex 3 of the Enforcement Rules of the KOSDAQ Market Listing Regulation

(Timely designation) When it confirms through the disclosure that the causes for “modified opinion on the internal accounting management system” in the audit report of the latest business year have arisen*, KRX designates an investment alert issue on the following day.
* KOSDAQ Market Listing Regulation §28-2

xf:group.xf:group: When a stock-listed corporation fails to meet disclosure obligations stipulated in the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act and the KOSPI Market Disclosure Regulation, or its disclosure falls under the categories of unfaithful disclosure (non-compliance with disclosure obligations, a reversal of disclosure, and making a significant change to the existing disclosure) by reversing or changing the previous disclosure, KRX designates the corporation as an unfaithful disclosure corporation.
